hero.title: Brands post briefs. Bloggers reply.
hero.lead: Brands publish promo briefs for free. Active bloggers with 5k–100k followers see the ones that fit them and apply — for money or barter.

preview.title: Dinner for two for a Reels
preview.subtitle: A cafe in the center is looking for 3 bloggers, 5k+ followers
preview.accepted: Your application is approved — the brand expects the post by Friday

how.title: From brief to post in four steps
how.lead: No agencies, no screenshots of follower counts.

post.title: A brand posts a brief
post.body: Country, city, audience size, age, gender, money or barter — as precise as the brand needs.

match.title: You see what fits you
match.body: Your feed shows only briefs you qualify for, each with a 0–100 match score. Apply with a short pitch.

accept.title: The brand says yes
accept.body: Once you're accepted, you both see each other's contacts. Not before.

publish.title: You post, they confirm
publish.body: Publish the content, drop the link, and the brand marks the collab as done.

brands.title: Find bloggers whose audience is your customer

points.a: Post as many briefs as you like — free.
points.b: See real followers, engagement and audience before you say yes.
points.c: A live counter shows how many verified bloggers match your brief.

influencers.title: Collabs that fit you, not spam in your DMs

points.a: A feed of briefs you actually qualify for, best matches first.
points.b: Money, barter or both — you choose. Models who work for barter are welcome.
points.c: First month free, then 9.99 per month.

oauth.title: Official APIs only
oauth.body: Bloggers connect Instagram, TikTok and YouTube through the official login. Followers and engagement come straight from the platform.

review.title: Checked by people
review.body: We review every blogger profile before it can apply. Brands see a Verified badge and links to the real accounts.

match.title: A fair match score
match.body: The score weighs niche, engagement, audience gender, age, country and language — and shows you why.

cta.title: Your next collab starts with a brief
cta.lead: Create a free brand account and post your first brief in five minutes.

brands.title: Influencer marketing without guesswork
brands.lead: Post a brief, see how many verified bloggers match it, and choose by real numbers.

targeting.title: Precise targeting
targeting.body: Country, city, platform, followers, engagement, blogger and audience gender and age, content language.

reach.title: Reach before you post
reach.body: The brief form shows a live count of verified bloggers who match your filters.

applicants.title: Compare applicants
applicants.body: Sort by match or followers, see the audience split and open every connected profile.

contacts.title: Talk directly
contacts.body: Accept a blogger and you both get each other's contacts. No middlemen, no commission.

influencers.title: Collabs that fit your audience
influencers.lead: Connect your accounts once, get verified, and apply to briefs that match your niche and followers.

feed.title: A feed made for you
feed.body: Only briefs you qualify for, sorted by a match score that explains the fit.

verified.title: Verified badge
verified.body: Your stats come from official APIs, so brands trust them — and you.

track.title: Track every application
track.body: Applied, viewed, shortlisted, accepted — you always know where you stand.

fair.title: Honest price
fair.body: First month free. Then 9.99 per month, cancel any time.

pricing.title: Simple pricing
pricing.lead: Brands post for free. Bloggers pay a small monthly fee to apply.

card.q: Do I need a card for the free month?
card.a: No. You add a card only when you decide to subscribe.

cancel.a: Yes, any time. You keep access until the end of the paid month.

cards.a: Visa, Mastercard and ArCa. Payments are processed by Ameriabank.
